[line]

Welcome to [b]QiMod Manager[/b], a comprehensive, fast, and elegant mod manager specifically built for [b]SMAPI Android[/b] (NRTnarathip's port).

Featuring native integration with both SMAPI Android and the Nexus Mods API, QiMod Manager gives you total control over your Stardew Valley mobile experience. Manage, download, and update your mods seamlessly from a beautifully designed interface.

[line]
[size=5][b]✨ Key Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Native Nexus Integration:[/b] Uses your Personal API Key, ensuring all your downloads are safely synced and tracked in your Nexus Mods download history.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Dependency Handling:[/b] Automatically detects and prompts you to download required dependencies when installing directly from Nexus (if configured correctly by the mod creator).[/*]
[*][b]Update Management:[/b] Easily check for mod updates and upgrade them directly within the app.[/*]
[*][b]Advanced File Selection:[/b] Full installation control. Choose exactly which file version to download when a mod offers multiple main or optional files.[/*]
[*][b]Direct SMAPI Writing:[/b] Writes directly to your SMAPI mods folder—no messy manual file moving required.[/*]
[*][b]Beautiful & Fluid UI:[/b] Enjoy an intuitive interface with smooth swipe navigation between mod tabs and a convenient pull-to-refresh feature in your "Installed Mods" list.[/*]
[*][b]Customizable Themes:[/b] Choose from 4 sleek themes: 2 Light and 2 Dark (with one of each featuring native Material You support).[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=5][b]📥 4 Versatile Installation Methods[/b][/size]

Whether you prefer browsing on the web or managing files locally, QiMod Manager adapts to your workflow:
[list=1]
[*][b]Vortex Button:[/b] Install mods directly from the Nexus Mods website using the "Mod Manager Download" button.[/*]
[*][b]By Mod ID:[/b] Quickly install by manually entering the Nexus Mod ID into the app.[/*]
[*][b]Local Install:[/b] Select and install individual mod .zip files directly from your phone's local storage.[/*]
[*][b]Bulk Install:[/b] Save massive amounts of time by bulk-installing an entire folder of .zip mods at once![/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=5][b]🚀 First Time Setup & Migration Guide[/b][/size]

Setting up QiMod Manager is a breeze, but requires a few quick steps on your first launch to ensure everything runs perfectly:

[b]1. API Key Setup[/b]
Upon launching the app, you will be prompted to enter your Personal Nexus API Key. [i](Don't have one? The app provides a direct link to the Nexus page to generate it).[/i]

[b]2. Folder Permissions[/b]
Next, you will need to grant the app read/write access to your SMAPI mods folder:
[code]Data/android/abc.smapi.gameloader/files/Mods[/code]
[b]3. Mod Migration (Important!)[/b]
For QiMod Manager to properly track and manage your existing mods, they must be imported and installed through the app.
[list]
[*][color=#e6a822][b]If you already have mods installed:[/b][/color] You will enter the Migration screen. To make this seamless, we highly recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48940]ModXter[/url] mod. It is the only tool that allows you to easily export your current SMAPI mods to an external folder (Downloads/ModXter), allowing QiMod Manager to quickly bulk-install them.[/*]
[*][color=#42b883][b]If you are starting fresh:[/b][/color] You have zero mods installed? Great! Simply skip this step.[/*]
[/list]
[b]4. You're All Set![/b]
The main screen will open, and you are ready to enjoy 100% of QiMod Manager's features!
